name: Planning a Pasadena Kitchen Remodel? Avoid These Common Mistakes.

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Dreaming of a new kitchen is exciting, but tackling a remodel, especially in a classic Pasadena home, can be tricky. It's easy to get lost in tile choices and cabinet styles, but a smooth project starts with avoiding a few common pitfalls.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: First, don't underestimate the planning phase. Before any walls come down, have a detailed layout finalized. This includes knowing the exact specs for your new appliances and planning where every outlet and light switch will go. Making these decisions mid-project often leads to delays and compromises. Second, never assume you don't need a permit. In Pasadena, moving a gas line, altering plumbing, or adding a new electrical circuit almost always requires a permit and inspections. It's a crucial step for safety and compliance. Finally, prepare for the unexpected. Older homes can hide surprises like outdated plumbing or rotted wood. A smart budget includes a contingency fund (around 10-15%) to cover unforeseen issues without derailing your project.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Navigating permits and unexpected repairs is where a professional shines. To ensure your project is built to last, contact YOR Construction & Investments for a free consultation to get started.
